scenario: The ego vehicle navigates a roundabout while an adversarial vehicle enters the same roundabout from an adjacent approach.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane, then enters and navigates the roundabout, exiting onto a new road.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels forward and enters the roundabout from an adjacent approach, circulating within the roundabout alongside the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: Both the ego and adversarial vehicles are on a multi-lane road approaching a large roundabout with a central island; the ego starts on one approach while the adversarial car starts on a perpendicular approach to the roundabout.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the roundabout are defined for both vehicles, and the scenario terminates once both vehicles have exited the roundabout.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned near the roundabout entry on the right side of the ego vehicle's approach.
Located along the sidewalk on the right side of the road near the roundabout.
